entries.dfbcc1782c91e38f: Under its medium-term management plan 'Beyond Growth: Toward What Lies Beyond Growth', it is pursuing 'selection and concentration', focusing management resources on sales channels and product brands centered on the affluent market. In sales strategy, it is strengthening existing channels (department stores and wholesale) and developing new markets (the direct market, the affluent market and overseas markets); in product strategy, it aims to focus on and nurture its three core luxury brands, NADIA, DAVID MORRIS and SCAVIA, and to establish its own brand 'NAGAHORI'. As its vision for ten years from now, it sets out the goal of 'firmly establishing its position as a leading company in the jewelry industry'.
